name: Unleavened Bread
overview: Scripture reveals the feast of Unleavened Bread as a divinely appointed observance commemorating Israel's hasty deliverance from Egypt, marked by eating unleavened bread for seven days (Exodus 12:15, 18; Leviticus 23:6). This bread symbolizes the bread of affliction and the urgency of departure, reminding God's people to remove leaven from their homes as a sign of holiness and separation (Deuteronomy 16:3; Exodus 12:15). The feast is a sacred time instituted by the Lord, emphasizing obedience and remembrance of His mighty acts in redemption (Leviticus 23:1, 6).
